phase: 17 — Animated Human Characters and Activity Clips

characterArtDirection.tone: Dignified, professional, restrained Indian legal tribunal
characterArtDirection.palette: Paper-and-Ink design system: warm ivory, obsidian ink, civic indigo, subdued brass
characterArtDirection.silhouette: Formal modern business attire, blazers, Nehru collars, dignified hair, distinct chair robes

evaluatedLibraries.name: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library
evaluatedLibraries.attribution: Microsoft Corporation & Rocketbox Studios (2020). Released for research, avatars, and real-time embodiment.
evaluatedLibraries.rigFormat: Biped Skeleton (58-65 bones), Mixamo-compatible joint orientations
evaluatedLibraries.evaluationNotes: High-fidelity professional clothing (suits, office wear). Unoptimized FBX models require conversion to GLB and texture atlasing. Lacks legal desk-specific clips (verbatim document reading, statutory checking, folio handoff) which must be custom-authored.

evaluatedLibraries.name: KayKit Character & Animation Pack
evaluatedLibraries.author: Kay Lousberg
evaluatedLibraries.evaluationNotes: Useful for low-poly animation timing and locomotion validation, but fantasy adventurer clothing (armor, boots, cloaks) clashes with the required tribunal courtroom setting. Used as a structural reference for locomotion bone timing.

unifiedRigSpecification.drawCallOptimization: Shared geometry templates, instanced materials, SkeletonUtils.clone per instance
